messages:
Carla (PM): Quick proposal — per-tenant staged rollout for the new CC routing feature. Primary goals: let CS opt high-touch customers in, protect overall latency/cost SLOs, and allow fast auto-quarantine for noisy tenants.
Ben (Eng): +1. Implementation sketch: global flag + per-tenant override + telemetry gates. Start with 1% tenant canary, expand by telemetry.
Raj (SRE): We need concrete fallback rules: per-tenant circuit-breaker, region-aware fail-open, and a hard QPS cap when routing to the new path.
Miguel (ProdOps): Ops runbook idea: if tenant error_rate > 0.5% for 5m OR latency_p95 increases > 2x baseline for 10m, auto-quarantine tenant for 10m and notify CS.
Carla (PM): Draft policy snippet below — feedback?
```yaml
flag: cc_tiered_routing
stages:
  - name: canary
    percent_tenants: 1
    telemetry_gate:
      window: 5m
      metrics:
        - latency_p95: < 500ms
        - error_rate: < 0.005
  - name: regional_expand
    percent_tenants: 10
    regions: [us-west-2, eu-central-1]
  - name: global
    percent_tenants: 100
fallbacks:
  - strategy: revert-to-primary-model
  - per_tenant_quarantine: 10m
  - hard_qps_cap_multiplier: 2.0
```
Ben (Eng): Two asks: 1) make telemetry_gate use rolling EWMA vs tenant baseline to avoid noisy small tenants blocking. 2) expose a manual "quarantine" API for CS/SRE with one-click undo.
Raj (SRE): +1 on EWMA. Also add a safety cap at infra level: never shift more than 2x baseline QPS to the new route for any tenant during first 24h.
Cora (CS): For predictable billing/customers, CS team needs an opt-in flow that can pin a tenant to a stage and an audit log. Also want webhook when tenant is auto-quarantined.
Miguel (ProdOps): Suggested rollout timeline: canary -> 24h monitor (health + perf) -> regional expand -> 72h monitor -> global over 7d ramp. Dashboard requirements: tenant filter, health per stage, quick-kill button.
Ben (Eng): Technical plan: add /feature-flags API to set per-tenant stage, implement telemetry-gates service (EWMA baseline), add webhook on-quarantine, and a short TTL quarantine key. Will sketch API today.
deploy-bot: cc_tiered_routing flag created in staging by Ben at 2141598800 :rocket:
Carla (PM): Decision: go ahead with per-tenant telemetry gates + auto-quarantine + manual override + CS webhook. Ben -> API + runbook. Raj -> infra caps + monitoring alerts. Miguel -> ops dashboard mock. Meeting scheduled tomorrow 10:00 for final scoping. :calendar:
